citation.title: Effect of energy dependent cross-section on flow velocity measurements with charge exchange spectroscopy in magnetized plasma
citation.authors: J. Chen, K. Ida, M. Yoshinuma, I. Murakami, T. Kobayashi, M.Y. Ye, B. Lyu

topic: Systematic apparent line shift from energy-dependent charge-exchange cross-sections in carbon and hydrogen CXS on LHD. The work uses a symmetric poloidal view layout and relates the shift to Ti, beam energy and n=2 donors.
own_question: How does the cross-section correction velocity depend on Ti and beam energy, and does the n=2 excited-state donor matter at low beam energy?
actual_method_and_evidence: The correction velocity is extracted from paired upward and downward channels. It shows a linear dependence on Ti in example shots. The authors compile statistics of Vcor/Ti across about 200 shots at one beam energy, plus a beam-energy scan. They compare these results with a model built from the normalized gradient of ADAS and Janev93 effective emission coefficients. The study uses offline LHD analysis, not KSTAR.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Reported CXS impurity quantities are model-processed spectral outputs. Their flow interpretation can carry systematic atomic-physics corrections that scale with Ti. This supports treating CES reports as conventional labels rather than independent truth.
claim_checks.qualification: The paper concerns velocity, not temperature labels. The authors state that the Ti correction was negligible in their dataset. The evidence comes from LHD carbon/hydrogen systems.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not relevant. There is no nowcasting, no report timing, and no BES/ECEI input.
validation_if_relevant: Validation is a statistical comparison with atomic models within LHD discharges. There are no held-out data.
forbidden_inferences: Do not claim this paper shows that KSTAR CES temperature is biased.
Do not claim it addresses real-time or causal estimation.
Do not generalize LHD results to the KSTAR pedestal-top chord.
Do not treat the fitted n=2 fraction as established physics.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: At most, this paper could serve as an optional citation that CES outputs depend on atomic-data modeling. It does not bear on temperature nowcasting and is not needed.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
